incompatibilities: TrujilloTileDataset reads from DatasetManifest (Part-I schema), not ops01_physical_dataset_manifest_v3.json
TrujilloTileDataset expects 2-band images; OPS-01 has 1-band VV
TrujilloTileDataset yields binary masks {0,1}; OPS-01 masks are multi-class 0-14
TrujilloTileDataset uses windowed read from 2048x2048 GeoTIFF; OPS-01 reads whole 256x256 files
TrujilloTileDataset uses split via SplitName enum (TRAIN/VAL/TEST); OPS-01 uses TRAIN/DEV/HOLDOUT

ops01_dataloader_requirement: A new OPS-01-specific dataset class must be implemented before EXP-07 training. It must read from ops01_physical_dataset_manifest_v3.json, respect the TRAIN/DEV/HOLDOUT partition assignment, enforce Part-III firewall (no OPS-01 data must bleed into Part-III evaluation), and implement the chosen preprocessing pipeline.
required_contracts: TRAIN dataloader loads ONLY partition=TRAIN samples from manifest
DEV dataloader loads ONLY partition=DEV samples from manifest
HOLDOUT dataloader loads ONLY partition=HOLDOUT samples from manifest
No silent fallback to 'all data' mode under any error condition
No cross-partition sampling under class-balancing or oversampling
Firewall assertion must reject any Part-III data roots
Exception on missing file — no silent skip unless explicitly authorized
Exception on corrupted file — no silent substitution
Reproducibility: shuffle=True for TRAIN requires fixed seed at DataLoader construction
Augmentation: stochastic transforms only for TRAIN; identity transform for DEV/HOLDOUT
